//: Build profiles for EAS Build. See the note in README-ish form below.

development.//: A dev client: like Expo Go but with this app's own native modules compiled in. Needed only if a dependency stops working in Expo Go.

preview.//: The one to use. Produces a plain .apk you download and install by tapping it, with no Play Store and no signing ceremony. Android only; iOS device builds need a paid Apple Developer account.

production.//: An .aab for the Play Store. Not needed until you actually publish.
